title: ANTKEEPER - A Dungeon Keeper inspired Ant game
author: duimomlaag
selftext:
I used to play [Dungeon Keeper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dungeon_Keeper) all the time back in the day, so I've made a game inspired by it: Antkeeper.  
  
You manage an ant colony and you build your nest, find food and water in the overworld, train your soldier ants and defeat the enemy.   
  
Built with Claude Fable (ThreeJS, Blender), Suno for the soundtrack, Elevenlabs for the voices. Trailer video is made completely with Opus 5.5.  
  
You can try it out [here](http://ja.sperdeboer.nl/antkeeper). I'm still tweaking the levels, trying to balance it out. But I'm open to any feedback!

comments.author: TheBigQuestion354
comments.body: Actually a cool unique idea, I’m digging it

replies.author: duimomlaag
replies.body: Thank you! But I have to say the concept is heavily inspired by Dungeon Keeper

replies.author: TheBigQuestion354
replies.body: Dude you at least had a way better idea then “lol create dungeon keep” like so many posts I see on here. Keep going with your idea if you’re inspired!

comments.author: OneDay_OneLife
comments.body: Looks amazing, how did you get Opus5.5 to make the video? plugin?

replies.author: duimomlaag
replies.body: No plugin, just Claude Code with Playwright and ffmpeg. It drove the actual game in Chrome, staged every shot through a small debug hook (camera moves, zoom, building the rooms), and screen-recorded each one. Then it wrote a Python script that cuts the clips on the beat of the game's music, and rendered the title cards from an HTML canvas page frame by frame, then overlaid them with ffmpeg.
